purpose: Teach: むちゃくちゃ/聴こえ/だまし/気が付か/呟き/めげ/つかまえ/おさえ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のノート、むちゃくちゃだぞ
lines.en: Riku, your notes are all over the place.
lines.style: Teasing jab, quick rhythm. Slight smirk in the voice. Affectionate critique—she's not actually annoyed, just needling him for a reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生の話が聴こえないって、寝てたろ、桜
lines.en: You're the one who couldn't hear the teacher because you were passed out, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-shot, calm. Steady rhythm, slight lilt of amusement underneath. Not defensive—he's turning it back on her with the same warmth she gave.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、俺をだましてプリント忘れさせたな
lines.en: Riku, you tricked me into forgetting to grab the handout.
lines.style: Accusatory but light-hearted. Sharp attack on the first word. The 'you tricked me' carries mock-outrage—she's not actually upset, performing offense for the bit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、俺の頑張りに気が付かないなんてひどいぞ、桜
lines.en: You didn't even notice how hard I've been trying, Sakura. That's rough.
lines.style: Soft turn inward. Quieter register, genuine hurt surfacing underneath the banter. Slight pause before 'that's rough'—letting it land. He means it, but wrapped in playfulness so she knows he's still her friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト中に呟きで答え言うなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't answer the test questions out loud under your breath.
lines.style: Sharp reprimand, urgent tempo. Direct eye contact in the voice. She's actually telling him off here—protective, not teasing. Brief, because it matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、進路にめげずに頑張れよ、桜
lines.en: You've got to keep pushing through the college stuff, Sakura. Don't give up on yourself.
lines.style: Steady, grounded encouragement. Slow enough to mean it. Not inspirational speech—just him saying quietly that he believes in her. Small warmth beneath the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、迷子の犬をつかまえてくれて偉いぞ
lines.en: Riku, it was actually great that you caught that stray dog.
lines.style: Genuine praise, surprised at herself for saying it out loud. Warm tone, a little softer than her usual teasing. She's showing him she sees the good in him when he's not looking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト前に焦りをおさえろよ、桜
lines.en: Keep your nerves in check before the test, Sakura. You'll do fine.
lines.style: Calm, grounding presence. Slow, reassuring pace. He's not hyped-up or frantic—he's the steady one, talking her down from spiraling. Matter-of-fact kindness.
